query: Write a design doc on the tradeoffs between io_uring and epoll for a high-throughput proxy.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/prose-profile.md before drafting
Gathers real figures (syscall counts, benchmark numbers, kernel versions) before writing prose
Produces zero em-dashes
Uses 'For example' and 'such as' followed by named instances, at least twice combined
Names at least two options, states which is chosen and why
Volunteers a cost in the same paragraph as each claimed benefit
Runs scripts/check_style.py and iterates until it exits 0
Contains no data-platform or financial vocabulary from the derivation corpus

query: Here is a draft section I wrote. Check it against my style and fix what is off.
expected_behavior: Runs scripts/check_style.py on the draft first rather than eyeballing it
Reports the specific measured deviations, not a general impression
Fixes hard failures (em-dashes, banned tokens, second person, RFC uppercase modals)
Does not flatten sentence-length variance while fixing other issues
Re-runs the checker after editing to confirm it exits 0

query: Draft a one-pager proposing we move our metrics pipeline from cron to an event-driven trigger.
expected_behavior: Paragraph lengths vary, including at least one single-sentence paragraph
Does not produce uniformly 3-4 sentence paragraphs
Sentence lengths spread with sd >= 9 and at least one sentence over 40 words
Includes calibrated hedges for anything not under the author's control
Leaves at least one claim explicitly unresolved
Records reversibility of the decision
Ends on a technical fact rather than a summary paragraph
